The '''wife''' of [[Jicoln Cadera]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who [[Marriage/Legends|married]] Jicoln, joining [[Clan Cadera]]. Jicoln and his wife had a son, [[Torian Cadera|Torian]], and Jicoln kept the ceremonial marriage knot from his wedding as one of his most prized possessions.<ref name="TOR" />
